requirements.text: Offerors must hold an active Alliant 2 governmentwide acquisition contract at the time of proposal submission.
Offerors must be registered and active in SAM.gov under NAICS 541512 throughout the period of performance.
Key personnel proposed for the data architect role must hold an active Public Trust clearance.
5.1 The contractor shall migrate 62 analytical datasets totalling 140 terabytes to the agency's cloud data platform.
5.2 The contractor shall implement automated data quality checks for every migrated dataset.
5.3 The contractor shall achieve initial operating capability within 180 days of task order award.
5.4 The contractor must comply with the agency's data governance standard and the FedRAMP Moderate baseline.
5.5 The contractor shall provide monthly burn-down reporting against the migration backlog.
5.6 The contractor should propose reusable pipeline components and describe how they reduce future migration cost.
The technical proposal shall not exceed 30 pages, excluding the staffing matrix and resumes.
Submit Volume I Technical and Volume II Price as separate PDF files.
File names shall follow the pattern CompanyName_GS00Q26TO0031_Volume.pdf.
Proposals must be submitted through the GSA Assisted Acquisition portal by 5:00 PM Eastern Time on 19 November 2026.
Offerors shall submit a fully loaded labour rate table mapped to their Alliant 2 ceiling rates.
The Government will evaluate the technical approach, the transition risk and the realism of the 180-day schedule.
Past performance will be evaluated for relevancy to data platform migrations of at least 50 terabytes.
